name: Atlantis (STS-81)
about: Atlantis (STS-81) (1997-001A), a crewed vehicle (OV-104), launched 1997 Jan 12. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1997 Jan 14), held fixed
docked to A05709; GCAT's later phases (auxiliary catalogues) are not read yet

events.why: GCAT gives the launch without an hour
